rationale: The assistant separated the display-lit case from the dead-oven case, asked what the display showed, and then gave clear generic steps for setting the clock and returning to manual when the customer said there was no manual. It recommended no part, gave no unsafe instructions and did not escalate, which was correct. The oven was fixed. The second reply said 'very likely' a clock reset, which was slightly confident but fitted the flashing 0.00 and power cut. It also acknowledged that button sequences vary and offered further help. The first reply was a little long and listed both branches before the customer had given any evidence.
